model.shopflow_dbt.dim_customers.name: dim_customers
model.shopflow_dbt.dim_customers.description: One row per customer with region and order history (cancelled orders excluded).

model.shopflow_dbt.dim_products.name: dim_products
model.shopflow_dbt.dim_products.description: One row per product with the price converted to EUR.

model.shopflow_dbt.fct_daily_revenue.name: fct_daily_revenue
model.shopflow_dbt.fct_daily_revenue.description: One row per day and region. Net revenue in EUR (cancelled orders excluded).

daily_revenue_key.name: daily_revenue_key
daily_revenue_key.description: Surrogate key built from date_day and region.

model.shopflow_dbt.fct_events.name: fct_events
model.shopflow_dbt.fct_events.description: One row per deduplicated web event. Microbatch incremental model (one batch per day, lookback 2 days). Late events older than the lookback need a targeted backfill.

model.shopflow_dbt.fct_orders.name: fct_orders
model.shopflow_dbt.fct_orders.description: One row per order. Amounts in the order currency and in EUR.

model.shopflow_dbt.int_order_items__pric.name: int_order_items__priced
model.shopflow_dbt.int_order_items__pric.description: Order lines with the order currency, the monthly rate and the line amount in EUR.

model.shopflow_dbt.int_orders__enriched.name: int_orders__enriched
model.shopflow_dbt.int_orders__enriched.description: One row per order with totals, payments, refunds and EUR amounts.

model.shopflow_dbt.int_payments__per_ord.name: int_payments__per_order
model.shopflow_dbt.int_payments__per_ord.description: Ephemeral. Succeeded payments and refunds summed per order (order currency).

model.shopflow_dbt.stg_payments_provider.name: stg_payments_provider__payments
model.shopflow_dbt.stg_payments_provider.description: One row per payment attempt. amount is in currency units (cents / 100).

model.shopflow_dbt.stg_payments_provider.name: stg_payments_provider__refunds
model.shopflow_dbt.stg_payments_provider.description: One row per refund. refunded_at is a real timestamp.

model.shopflow_dbt.stg_shipping__shipmen.name: stg_shipping__shipments
model.shopflow_dbt.stg_shipping__shipmen.description: One row per shipment with its latest status.

model.shopflow_dbt.stg_shopflow_app__cus.name: stg_shopflow_app__customers
model.shopflow_dbt.stg_shopflow_app__cus.description: One row per customer (latest version), email cleaned (trim + lower case).

email.name: email
email.description: Lower-case email without spaces. Can be NULL.

model.shopflow_dbt.stg_shopflow_app__ord.name: stg_shopflow_app__order_items
model.shopflow_dbt.stg_shopflow_app__ord.description: One row per order line. Amounts are in the order currency.

model.shopflow_dbt.stg_shopflow_app__ord.name: stg_shopflow_app__orders
model.shopflow_dbt.stg_shopflow_app__ord.description: One row per order with its current status.

model.shopflow_dbt.stg_shopflow_app__pro.name: stg_shopflow_app__products
model.shopflow_dbt.stg_shopflow_app__pro.description: One row per product. price is in currency_code (EUR, USD or MAD).

model.shopflow_dbt.stg_web_analytics__ev.name: stg_web_analytics__events
model.shopflow_dbt.stg_web_analytics__ev.description: One row per tracked event, duplicates removed.

customer_id.name: customer_id
customer_id.description: NULL for visitors who are not logged in (relationships ignores NULLs).

seed.shopflow_dbt.country_regions.name: country_regions
seed.shopflow_dbt.country_regions.description: Country code -> country name, sales region and default currency.

seed.shopflow_dbt.exchange_rates.name: exchange_rates
seed.shopflow_dbt.exchange_rates.description: Monthly exchange rates used by finance. 1 unit of currency_code = rate_to_eur EUR. One row per currency and month (first day of the month).

snapshot.shopflow_dbt.products_snapshot.name: products_snapshot
snapshot.shopflow_dbt.products_snapshot.description: History of the product catalogue (price, active flag). The app keeps a reliable updated_at column, so we use the timestamp strategy.

snapshot.shopflow_dbt.shipments_snapshot.name: shipments_snapshot
snapshot.shopflow_dbt.shipments_snapshot.description: History of shipment statuses. We only want a new version when the status or the delivery time changes (not when the loader touches the row), so we use the check strategy.

source.shopflow_dbt.payments_provider.pa.name: payments
source.shopflow_dbt.payments_provider.pa.source_description: Daily export of the payment provider. Amounts are integers in CENTS.
source.shopflow_dbt.payments_provider.pa.description: One row per payment attempt (failed attempts included).

source.shopflow_dbt.payments_provider.re.name: refunds
source.shopflow_dbt.payments_provider.re.source_description: Daily export of the payment provider. Amounts are integers in CENTS.
source.shopflow_dbt.payments_provider.re.description: Money sent back to customers. refunded_at is TEXT (DD/MM/YYYY HH:MI).

source.shopflow_dbt.shipping.shipments.name: shipments
source.shopflow_dbt.shipping.shipments.description: One row per shipment, with its latest status.

source.shopflow_dbt.shopflow_app.address.name: addresses
source.shopflow_dbt.shopflow_app.address.source_description: Copy of the ShopFlow application database, loaded every night by the EL tool.
source.shopflow_dbt.shopflow_app.address.description: Shipping and billing addresses of the customers.

source.shopflow_dbt.shopflow_app.custome.name: customers
source.shopflow_dbt.shopflow_app.custome.source_description: Copy of the ShopFlow application database, loaded every night by the EL tool.
source.shopflow_dbt.shopflow_app.custome.description: One row per customer account (the export can contain an old copy of a row).

source.shopflow_dbt.shopflow_app.order_i.name: order_items
source.shopflow_dbt.shopflow_app.order_i.source_description: Copy of the ShopFlow application database, loaded every night by the EL tool.
source.shopflow_dbt.shopflow_app.order_i.description: One row per product line of an order. unit_price is in the order currency.

source.shopflow_dbt.shopflow_app.orders.name: orders
source.shopflow_dbt.shopflow_app.orders.source_description: Copy of the ShopFlow application database, loaded every night by the EL tool.
source.shopflow_dbt.shopflow_app.orders.description: One row per order, with its current status.

source.shopflow_dbt.shopflow_app.product.name: products
source.shopflow_dbt.shopflow_app.product.source_description: Copy of the ShopFlow application database, loaded every night by the EL tool.
source.shopflow_dbt.shopflow_app.product.description: Product catalogue. Prices are in the currency of the listing (EUR, USD or MAD).

source.shopflow_dbt.web_analytics.events.name: events
source.shopflow_dbt.web_analytics.events.source_description: Events sent by the website tracker (installed on 2025-10-01).
source.shopflow_dbt.web_analytics.events.description: One row per tracked event. The tracker sometimes sends an event twice.

unit_test.shopflow_dbt.dim_customers.tes.name: test_cancelled_orders_do_not_count
unit_test.shopflow_dbt.dim_customers.tes.description: number_of_orders and lifetime_value_eur ignore cancelled orders. A returned order counts as an order, but its net value is 0. A customer without orders gets 0 (not NULL).

unit_test.shopflow_dbt.fct_orders.test_f.name: test_fct_orders_incremental_keeps_only_recent_changes
unit_test.shopflow_dbt.fct_orders.test_f.description: In an incremental run, fct_orders only selects orders whose updated_at is at most 3 days older than the newest updated_at already in the table (input "this").

given.rows:
select 1 as order_id, 1000.00 as amount_paid, 0.00 as amount_refunded
union all
select 2 as order_id, 80.00 as amount_paid, 80.00 as amount_refunded

unit_test.shopflow_dbt.int_orders__enric.name: test_eur_conversion_uses_the_rate_of_the_order_month
unit_test.shopflow_dbt.int_orders__enric.description: An order is converted to EUR with the rate of ITS month and currency. Net amount = paid - refunded, converted with the same rate.

unit_test.shopflow_dbt.stg_web_analytics.name: test_duplicate_events_keep_the_first_copy
unit_test.shopflow_dbt.stg_web_analytics.description: When the tracker sends the same event_id twice, staging keeps the copy loaded first.
